text: Inuit are highly exposed to MeHg especially due to their consumption • Fetuses are most vulnerable to MeHg exposure, which affects brain • Selenoneine is a putative anti-oxidative molecule found in Inuit’s red • Aim : Investigate the protection afforded by selenoneine against (i) Achouba et al., 2019. Selenoneine is a major selenium species in beluga skin and red blood cells of Inuit from Nunavik. Chemosphere.
Measure MeHg accumulation in ZF tissues postselenoneine treatment to assess its demethylation.
• Microdissection of euthanized ZF head, eye and muscle tail (A).
• MeHg and selenoneine quantified by gas (MeHg) or liquid (selenoneine) chromatography coupled with inductively coupled plasma - mass spectrometry (C).
• apoptosis events (anti-active caspase 3 antibody), and • MeHg distribution (anti-MeHg antibody) in exposed-ZF embryo.
Axonal tracts labeled by anti-acetylated tubulin antibody • Zebrafish (ZF) model allows early exposure of embryos and real time analyses.
2-photon functional imaging on 7 dpf GCaMP larvae. Z-projection of anatomical stack with delineated regions of interest (A), and average intensity from 10 mn of neuronal spontaneous activity (B).
Single-blind measures on 5 dpf WT embryo. Morphometric (A, B, C) and heart beat measures (D).
Box plots show means and extrema for each condition. Asterics denote significant differences (* : p<0.05, *** : p<0.005), assessed by a one-way ANOVA followed by Tukey post-hoc test.
Early results : MeHg exposure on ZF seems to impact the larval development in a dose-dependent manner. Effects on heart rate are quite variable and not significantly different.
